request.style: English, male baritone solo, solo, cello, flute, harp, timpani, majestic and steady, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life
Year after year he traveled the circuit wide
Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah were the places he knew
Judging the people in every place he drew

[Chorus]
He returned to Ramah where his home was found
There he judged Israel on the sacred ground
And he built an altar to the LORD there
Keeping the promise with unceasing care

[Verse]
From the high places down to the valley floor
His voice raised the judgment to heaven's door
In Bethel he stood and in Gilgal he sat
Giving the people the answer they sought

[Chorus]
He returned to Ramah where his home was found
There he judged Israel on the sacred ground
And he built an altar to the LORD there
Keeping the promise with unceasing care

[Verse]
Mizpah saw his face with the people nearby
He judged Israel with justice and supply
Then back to Ramah his journey was done
In the house of his father, the work was begun

[Chorus]
He returned to Ramah where his home was found
There he judged Israel on the sacred ground
And he built an altar to the LORD there
Keeping the promise with unceasing care

[Outro]
Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life
